people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
translations.bsb: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
translations.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
translations.asv: When Christ, who is our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.
